def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.in_ministry(m uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.ministry_members
    where ministry_id = m and profile_id = auth.uid()
  ) and public.is_member()
$function$
name: in_ministry

def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select role = 'admin' from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()), false)
$function$
name: is_admin

def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select status <> 'inactive' from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()), false)
$function$
name: is_member
